title: Publish current ADPL app draft to Live

requirements.text: Promote the current draft build of the ADPL Payment Entry & Collection Tracking System to the Live (public) version now, without making additional functional changes.

quotes: It's ok make it live now

acceptanceCriteria: The Live version matches the latest draft version at the time this request is executed.
No additional code changes/features are introduced as part of publishing.
After publishing, the live URL loads the app successfully and the login screen is reachable.

constraints: Do not introduce new functionality or change existing behavior as part of going live.
User-facing text must remain in English.
nonGoals: Fixing the reported role mismatch issue (Admin selection still showing as User).
Changing role assignment rules for Internet Identity or user profiles.
Any UI/UX redesign or feature additions.
